name: Broad-Stripe Knit Track Pants (Worn)
description: A common item in Shelf thrift bins — wide-leg knit track pants in faded colors, usually with a contrast stripe down each leg that has seen better days. The elastic waistband is stretched out and often cinched with a cord or safety pin. Soft, comfortable, and completely unpretentious. Once a Tier 2 athletic brand's budget line; now a Shelf staple.
what_it_says: Comfort over everything. You're not performing for anyone.
worn_by: anyone who values comfort over appearance
manufacturer: Probably Corvex Sportswear (defunct budget line) / origin unclear
story_hooks: A specific colorway of these pants was issued to residents of a Shelf block shelter ten years ago — wearing them marks you as a survivor of whatever happened there.
Someone has sewn a slim, flat object into the waistband casing — it's been passed through four owners without anyone noticing.

physical_description.visual_profile: Slouchy, wide-leg silhouette that hangs generously from hip to ankle. The contrast stripes down each leg create vertical emphasis despite the relaxed cut. Overall impression is comfort-worn and lived-in—the kind of pants someone reaches for without thinking. Distinctly casual, non-threatening, invisible in a crowd.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed and generous through hip and thigh, widening slightly toward the ankle. High-rise waistband that sits naturally. The elastic has lost its tension, creating subtle gathering and sag. Crotch sits lower than contemporary cuts. Built for movement and lounging, not athleticism.
physical_description.primary_material: Synthetic knit blend—likely polyester-nylon mix with cotton content. Soft hand, low sheen, slight pilling evident on high-friction areas. Breathable but not moisture-wicking; purely functional.
physical_description.texture: Smooth surface with micro-texture from blended fibers. Shows pilling at hip pockets and inner thighs. Waistband elastic is visible and slightly degraded. Fabric drapes with soft folds rather than crisp creases.
physical_description.color_scheme: Faded primary color (gray, navy, or brown most common) with a single contrast stripe running down each outer leg. The stripe—once vibrant—is now muted and uneven in tone, suggesting sun-fade and repeated washing. Color variation across the garment from differential fading.
closures: Drawcord threaded through waistband (often knotted or safety-pinned to secure)
Side zip pockets with plastic sliders showing wear
distinctive_features: Contrast stripe down each leg—faded and slightly unraveling at edges
Visible brand tag (Corvex Sportswear) on interior—faded or partially removed
Pilling concentrated at hip and inner thigh from friction
Drawcord cinched with safety pin instead of traditional knot
Faint bleach stain or discoloration patch on left thigh
Hem shows minor fraying; original sewn edge still visible
Interior waistband seam visible from stretching
Slight bagging at knees from repeated sitting
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 / Shelf economy. Once Tier 2 athletic budget line; now exclusively found in thrift, salvage, or sub-grade circulation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Shelf dweller, gig worker, or someone who values comfort over presentation. Worn by people cycling through Corvex athletic lines before they hit the thrift bins—construction workers, warehouse staff, night-shift service jobs. No aspirational content. Signals practical utility and detachment from consumption cycles.
physical_description.condition_typical: Weathered and patched. Expect stretched waistband, faded color, minor staining, pilling, and worn hem. The drawcord is often replaced or secured with safety pins. Seams may show slight fraying. Completely worn-in, not broken-down—it's just *tired*.

image_prompt: Worn Corvex Sportswear track pants on a lean, angular neo-noir figure in dim neon warehouse lighting. Wide-leg knit silhouette with faded charcoal base and dulled contrast stripe running down each leg. Drawcord cinched with visible safety pin at waistband. Pilling visible at hip and inner thigh. Shot from waist-down against a weathered metal wall with green biolume accent light casting shadows. Dark, moody, unglamorous. --ar 2:3 --v 6
